blurb: Alley Kat Lane offers 26 lanes of candlepin bowling, an arcade with over 45 games, and facilities for birthday parties, private parties, fundraisers, and corporate events. Guests can enjoy bowling, arcade games, food, and drinks in a family-friendly environment. The venue also hosts Rock n' Bowl events on Saturday nights with music and disco lights.
